messages:
Michelle: Quick check — can I enable a temporary full request/response capture for a single staging session (session id: abc123) for 24h to repro a customer bug? Need to inspect prompt/response mismatch. Asking for security sign-off and redaction guidance. @Ashwin FYI
Ashwin: Are you planning to capture raw tokens or KV cache? We should never persist raw prompt tokens or embeddings. Recommend hashing identifiers and redacting emails/phones. :eyes:
Michelle: Only staging and only that session. Plan: capture bodies to an ephemeral bucket with strict ACLs. Will mask `Authorization` headers and fields named `token`/`prompt_text`. Example proposed config below.
```
capture: true
fields_to_mask: ["Authorization", "token", "prompt_text", "user.email", "user.phone"]
hash_fields: ["user.id"]
retention_hours: 24
```
Kevin: I'd prefer redact for prompt_text rather than storing raw. For debugging, HMAC-hash of prompt_text + storing deltas might be enough to repro without PII. Also explicitly disallow embeddings capture in this window. :+1:
Sam: From support side — customer consented to debug access for their session only, they emphasized no PII can leave their tenant. We can do 24h window. 👍
Ashwin: Approve with conditions: 1) rotate creds and short-lived tokens, 2) bucket must be security-only ACL, 3) absolutely no embeddings or raw auth tokens stored (these must be redacted server-side), 4) add an audit record listing who accessed it and why. If you can't reliably redact `prompt_text`, then do not capture it. I'll sign off after infra confirms ACLs.
infra-bot: deploy-log: created temp-bucket `staging-debug-1865432100` (ACL: restricted, lifecycle: 24h)
Michelle: I'll implement HMAC hashing for `prompt_text` and remove any `token` fields before persistence. Will DM @Ashwin the ACL link + add the audit entry with the exact scrub config.
Ashwin: LGTM — include the scrub config in the audit and list the two engineers who will have access. I'll grant access after I see the ACL link.
Michelle: Done — posted scrub config to audit and DM'd the ACL. Starting capture now for 24h. Will close thread when capture is off. Thanks all!
